In the hierarchy, drag a bone onto another bone to place it under that bone, or onto the Node header to place it at the top of the skeleton. Drag a dummy onto a bone to attach it to that bone or move it into the bone's space.
Bones and dummies keep their place in the model when moved.
{0} can't be placed under {1}, which is the bone itself or one of the bones below it.
Attach to {0}
The dummy follows this bone (its Attach Bone). It stays where it is.
Move into the space of {0}

The dummy's position is measured from this bone (its Parent Bone), and it is listed under it. It stays where it is.

The games place each dummy in a Dmypoly group bone, so this is rarely what is wanted.
